sections.description: Every section from the input, in the order they should appear in the report. Spec section 7: the outliner may reorder and retitle, and nothing else. outline.validate is the real check — this schema only fixes the shape, it cannot tell a dropped hypothesis from a short outline.

id.description: Copied verbatim from the input. Section ids are assigned by code from the graph's theme order and are not the outliner's to choose.

title.description: The section heading. May be rewritten for readability. The pattern rejects a title that is only whitespace, which minLength alone admits.
